Package org.codehaus.mojo.license.extended.spreadsheet

Class SpreadsheetFormatting

java.lang.Object
org.codehaus.mojo.license.extended.spreadsheet.SpreadsheetFormatting
public class SpreadsheetFormatting extends Object
How the Excel and Calc writers should mark up the licenses they write.

This lives in src/main/java rather than next to the writer that reads it, because CalcFileWriter exists twice: the Java 11 implementation and the stub that replaces it on Java 8.

Since:
2.8.0

    • hasBorder

      public boolean hasBorder()
      Whether a highlighted license is also boxed in. A border tells the categories apart at a glance, at the cost of making one license of a multi-license dependency look like the only one.
      Returns:
      whether to draw a border around a highlighted license

    • skipsDevelopers

      public boolean skipsDevelopers()
      Whether the developers of a dependency are left out. They are rarely what a license report is read for, and they are the main reason one dependency takes a dozen rows. The columns stay, they are simply empty.
      Returns:
      whether to leave the developers out
